(CVE

109618 and CVE
-

109619)
 
Published: October 23, 2026
 
Updated: November 3, 2026
 
Xerox is aware of the recently disclosed critical vulnerabilities in the PHP runtime, known as “PHP2Shell” 
and tracked as CVE
-
2026
-
109618 and CVE
-
2026
-
109619. The PHP project has released fixed versions.
 
Our Product Security team is reviewing Xerox products, solutions and services to find out whether any use 
affected versions of PHP and whether these vulnerabilities can be exploited in those products. Where a 
product is affected, we will prioritize fixes a
nd release them as quickly as possible. We will share 
mitigations or workarounds sooner where they are available.

Mitigations for Affected Xerox® AltaLink®, EC81xx, VersaLink® and WorkCentre® 
Products
 
The vulnerable PHP component is used by a limited number of pages in the device’s Embedded Web 
Server. Until the fix is available and installed, customers can reduce their exposure with the following 
measures:
 
•
 
Restrict network access to the device: 
Make sure the device’s web interface (HTTP/HTTPS) can only 
be reached from trusted networks or management hosts, for example with a firewall or network 
segmentation. Devices that are protected by a properly configured firewall and are not directly 
accessib
le from the internet are at substantially reduced risk of exploitation.
 
•
 
Disable HTTP/HTTPS if it is not needed: 
If remote web
-
based administration is not required, 
HTTP/HTTPS can be disabled on the device. Disabling HTTP/HTTPS also disables the Embedded Web 
Server and any features that depend on it. Customers should evaluate the operational impact before 
applying th
is change.
 
•
 
Install the fix when it is released: 
This bulletin will be updated when software updates for these 
products are available.
